title: Wasserstein Random Forests and Applications in Heterogeneous Treatment Effects
target: Conditional marginal law of distribution-valued potential outcomes
observation_regime: Causal two-arm data; observed scalar or multivariate/distribution-valued responses
method: Wasserstein random forests; weighted empirical measure output; intra- and inter-class Wasserstein splits
guarantee_or_inference: Causal application estimates arm-specific conditional marginal laws; predictive forest-weight construction
remaining_gap: No treatment-aware boosting, proper-score particle projection, or explicit fixed-M energy-score law fit

title: Causal-DRF: Conditional Kernel Treatment Effect Estimation using Distributional Random Forest
target: Conditional kernel treatment effect / contrast of arm-specific laws
observation_regime: Causal two-arm data with multivariate or quantile-vector representation
method: One treatment-aware distributional forest with CKTE-targeted split criterion and Gaussian kernel
guarantee_or_inference: Consistency, convergence rate, asymptotic normality, and sampling distribution under assumptions
remaining_gap: Different fitted target from fixed-M arm-law projection; no ensemble-coupled energy-score particles

title: WGBoost: Wasserstein Gradient Boosting for Uncertainty Forecasting
observation_regime: Noncausal supervised data; a distribution is supplied for each input
method: Particle-wise Wasserstein gradient boosting with smoothed KL-type gradient and approximate Newton update
guarantee_or_inference: Algorithmic optimization method; no causal identification result
remaining_gap: No potential-outcome treatment learner and no empirical energy score on observed quantile-vector outcomes

title: Causal Inference for Distributional Outcomes
exact_supporting_location: Sections 2-3; Wasserstein causal effect map and barycenter definitions
target: Causal effect map and barycenter-based effects for distribution-valued outcomes
method: Identification and doubly robust causal effect estimation in Wasserstein space
guarantee_or_inference: Identification, estimation, and asymptotic theory for causal distributional effects
remaining_gap: Not a conditional-law learner and not a tree/boosting particle algorithm

title: Multivariate Bayesian Causal Forests
target: Multivariate causal outcome means and covariance structure
method: Shared Bayesian tree structures with vector leaf parameters and residual covariance
remaining_gap: No random-measure target or finite-M proper-score projection

title: Semiparametric Mixed-Scale Models Using Shared Bayesian Additive Regression Trees
target: Multiple model components with shared information
guarantee_or_inference: Bayesian semiparametric modeling with information sharing
remaining_gap: No causal conditional-law target; adaptive pooling requires a new demonstrated result

title: multiVCBART: Multivariate Causal Inference with Bayesian Additive Regression Trees
target: Multivariate causal response surfaces with joint residual dependence
method: Outcome-specific BART surfaces plus sparse graphical-Horseshoe residual precision
guarantee_or_inference: Bayesian posterior inference and causal effect estimation
remaining_gap: No distribution-valued potential-outcome law, fixed-M projection, or energy-score particles

title: Functional Outcome Causal Learning
guarantee_or_inference: Double robustness for functional pseudo-outcomes and final effect
remaining_gap: Targets functional conditional means/effects rather than full conditional arm laws

title: Wasserstein Policy Learning
target: Policy value with utility of Wasserstein barycenter of distribution-valued potential outcomes
observation_regime: Causal potential outcomes with distribution-valued responses
method: IPW and doubly robust Wasserstein policy learning
guarantee_or_inference: Policy regret and policy optimization guarantees
remaining_gap: Different policy estimand and no conditional-law learner

title: Distributional Random Forests
exact_supporting_location: Definition of distributional random forests and forest-weight law estimation
method: Forest-weight conditional distribution estimation with distributional split criteria
guarantee_or_inference: Predictive consistency and distributional inference results
remaining_gap: No treatment assignment or potential-outcome construction; mandatory predictive baseline

title: Engression: Extrapolation through the Lens of Distributional Regression
method: Generative distributional regression motivated by proper scoring
remaining_gap: No treatment-aware tree learner or potential-outcome law target

title: Distributional Split Criteria for Random Forests: Extensions, Shrinkage, and the Robustness of Mean Splitting
method: MMD, anisotropic, adaptive, and sliced-Wasserstein split criteria with shrinkage
guarantee_or_inference: Empirical distributional forest performance and robustness analysis
remaining_gap: Not causal, not boosting, and not proper-score particle projection; raises generic-tree novelty risk

title: Scoring rule nets: beyond mean target prediction in multivariate regression
guarantee_or_inference: Distributional prediction comparison with distributional random forests
